title: Answer: free will is real, since only what truly exists can cause, and a conscious subject truly exists

statements.text: Integrated information theory holds that there is free will in the fundamental sense. What truly exists in physical terms are intrinsic entities, and only what truly exists can cause. A conscious subject is such an entity and its neurons are not, so the subject has true alternatives, makes true decisions and is the true cause of its willed actions. The agent of a willed action is the subject itself, not its neurons or atoms.Indeterminism is not what makes the will free: free will is compatible with a high degree of determinism and even requires it.
statements.scope: the essay Only what exists can cause: an intrinsic powers view of free will (2022)
